create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for a given maximum angular momentum lmax
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin through lmax using symmetry to halve computation
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from quaternion Ra and Rb real and imaginary parts using real arithmetic for torch.compile compatibility
precompute_U_blocks_euler_aligned_real: precompute Euler-aligned U transformation matrices as real and imaginary pairs for converting complex to real spherical harmonics
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform Wigner D matrices from complex real-pair representation to real basis using precomputed U transformation blocks
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor in wxyz convention into the real and imaginary parts of complex numbers Ra and Rb
